authority: #K2-544 (PK final ruling): adopts the R1844 revised five answers as the base plus the global negotiation risk; orders ONE merged construction order. DATA ONLY - no code is changed until the supervisor approves this order (#K2-544 sec.2).
death_cause_one_line: The engine already OWNS the movers (move-parts multi-part --moves / block.move_block / regen.relocate_relative_chain / block.census / swept) but OWNS NO PLANNER and NO REGISTERED STANDARD: there is no declared partition, the objective is not a data artifact, and the reconnect face it must lean on (the maze) is greedy + order-sensitive with a POLLUTED adoption criterion - so multi-block moves would starve at a rate we have already measured.
proven_facts: STAGE COST (measured, this session's 9/9 chain): maze 235 s = 67% of ~348 s; copper_join 71.5 s = 21%; everything else (unfill/stitch/escape/channels/refill/islands/judge) ~41 s. Any planner that adds maze work pays 67% first.
MAZE KERNEL (profile, in-register): Grid.__init__ 924 builds ~258 s; astar 384 calls ~321 s (cProfile-inflated; real run 268-281 s for the same maze).

BOTTLENECK IS RASTERISATION, NOT RAY-CASTING: a frame-sized window Grid build measures 0.15-0.28 s; a point-in-polygon test over 6000 parts is milliseconds. => the block model must REUSE the maze's window/Grid machinery, not add a geometry path.

REPRESENTATIVE-ANCHOR CLASS (fixed, R1840): an edge whose representative anchor lands outside the work domain can never start (R1430 disease); the rule 'the start anchor is an ENDPOINT OF THIS NET'S OWN LAID COPPER, decided at solve time against the current landscape' closes it - and the boundary predicate needed an explicit tolerance (the port sits 1e-6 outside the wall; 1e-9 silently did NOT fire).
PROBE FIDELITY (measured): the single-net maze probe is GREEN both before and after the fix while the chain was RED - a single-net probe CANNOT certify this class.

RE-CONNECT FACE IS A CLOSER BUT WAS A FALSE GREEN TWICE: the hardened join (33 stitches / 16 refusals in the 9/9 run) closed the last unconnected net with ZERO new DRC classes; but its rc=0 was a false green in two prior windows (R1760, R1808) until six named fixes.

ADOPTION CRITERION IS BLINDED (measured): of 268 'blocked' edges in the 9/9-era maze, 245 are no-op-after-port-substitution(same-island) = ALREADY CONNECTED THROUGH THE FRAME. The rip-up adoption test ('block count strictly drops') therefore can never fire (3 rounds 268/268/268, adopted=False).
RESERVATION GEOMETRY DRIFTS (measured): the escape reservation derived from the planned asset was ~0.2 mm off the corridor the net actually needed, so another net capped it by 0.04 mm.

DRC REPRESENTATIVE NONDETERMINISM (in-register note): the DRC names an arbitrary representative item inside an equipotential island => connectivity must be compared as ISLAND PARTITIONS, not as DRC rows.
C6 GAUGE IS IN-REGISTER: outside_geometry + allow_outside_dR + the calibrated row tolerance tol_row = min(geom ring bound, max(0.5 mm2, 0.5% x ref_area)); reuse it, do not fork a second caliber.
SUITE = 183/183 (the hard regression net; 181 before R1840's two additions).

corrected_complete_plan.A_cleanup: REUSE block.census (three-way ledger: in-block / crossing / foreign) + block.move_block (one rewrite: move pads, translate in-block copper, CLIP the crossing nets keeping the outside half as a FIXED PORT). The acceptance assertion is 'the OLD region contains no copper of the MOVED nets' - NOT 'the old region is empty' (the clipped outside halves, the fixed ports and foreign copper all legitimately stay). Order is unfill -> move -> refill, reusing pour_aware_unfill / refill_frame_discipline. 'Outside-frame movement = 0' uses the registered outside_geometry.
corrected_complete_plan.B_partition: Block = a UNION OF RECTANGLES (the domain vehicle the maze already has: WALL_RECT / --channels; a multi-slot channel is refused by construction, R1420). NEVER build a new polygon vehicle. Constraints: the rect must not cut any pad/via/hole (or the three-way split degenerates); expand by courtyard+margin then QUANTISE OUTWARD to the registered frame lattice. DECLARED PARTITION COMES FIRST; automatic partitioning (union-find + clustering) is a later item, never a prerequisite.
corrected_complete_plan.C_standard: Objective = sum over nets of (number of blocks it crosses x block-centre distance) + HS-length / power-proximity penalties, REGISTERED AS A JSON STANDARD (auditable; never a code constant). Enumeration = positions ONLY (no block permutations - they are label-symmetric), hard caps (<=8 quantised positions per block, <=4 blocks per window), deterministic tie-break tuple.
corrected_complete_plan.D_determinism: Every predicate carries an EXPLICIT tolerance (the 1e-6 boundary class), every tie is broken by an explicit tuple, every search carries an explicit hard cap. Byte-level reproducibility is PROVEN with the in-register harness: two ledgers must cmp byte-identical (the K2MR_NOCACHE pair pattern) - do not invent a second proof.
corrected_complete_plan.E_qc_nine_rows: Nine rows, not eight: add 'stitch/placement-gate footprint = zero new DRC classes' as a PRECONDITION (not a post-hoc check). Row C2 copies the registered caliber (total <= cap AND new_classes == []); connectivity is compared as ISLAND PARTITIONS (f1.islands), never as DRC rows; the blocked/refusal counts are taken AFTER removing the same-island no-ops.
corrected_complete_plan.negotiation_fix_MANDATORY: Because the reconnect face is greedy and order-sensitive (measured: one net sealed by two others' copper), the order MUST include the negotiation fix: drop no-op(same-island) from the blocked set, count REAL blocks, and keep the bounded rip-up. Without it the planner's own quality metric is meaningless.
